name: DeepWiki Open AI Wiki for Your Repos
description: Turn any GitHub, GitLab or Bitbucket repo into an AI wiki with Q&A.

upstream.version: main @ d92819a (2026-09-03; no releases or tags) = ghcr.io/asyncfuncai/deepwiki-open:sha-d92819a

PORT.description: Public port (Caddy). Railway health-checks /health here; UI and API stay on localhost.

BASIC_AUTH_USERNAME.description: Login name for the DeepWiki UI and API (letters, digits, . _ @ -).

BASIC_AUTH_PASSWORD.description: Login password (generated; read it here). Everything except /health requires it.

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: Required. OpenAI key for wiki/chat generation and embeddings. Gemini only? Enter none.

GOOGLE_API_KEY.description: Optional. Gemini API key; used for generation and embeddings when OPENAI_API_KEY is none.

OPENROUTER_API_KEY.description: Optional. Adds OpenRouter models to the UI (embeddings still need OpenAI or Gemini).

OLLAMA_HOST.description: Optional. URL of your own Ollama server (e.g. http://ollama.railway.internal:11434).

DEEPWIKI_PROVIDER.description: Provider preselected in the UI: auto (first key set), openai, google, openrouter, ollama.

DEEPWIKI_MODEL.description: Optional default model id for that provider. Empty: gpt-6-luna / gemini-3.8-flash.

DEEPWIKI_EMBEDDER_TYPE.description: Embeddings: empty = auto (openai, google or ollama). Changing it needs a re-index.

DEEPWIKI_AUTH_MODE.description: true = UI also asks DEEPWIKI_AUTH_CODE before generating/deleting. Not a login.

DEEPWIKI_AUTH_CODE.description: Code for DEEPWIKI_AUTH_MODE (generated). Only used when that mode is true.

DEEPWIKI_CPU_THREADS.description: Optional. FAISS/numpy threads; empty = from the service CPU limit, max 8.

DEEPWIKI_MAX_CONCURRENT_WIKI_TASKS.description: Optional. Wikis generated at the same time; empty = half the CPU limit (min 1).

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Shutdown grace so open chats and streams close cleanly on redeploy.
